The first layer holds the azure blue of Sunward Island at dawn, when clear seawater rolls across the beach.
The second layer holds the brilliant gold of a lazy afternoon, with sunlight filtering through gauze curtains.
The third layer holds the deep crimson of sunset. As the last glow fades beyond the horizon, another day on Sunward Island draws to a close.

Description.LocalizedString: A signature treat from the Haunted House Diner! The ghost-shaped ice cream melts slowly, revealing a tiny mischievous ghost within.

UseContext.SourceString: 队伍中所有角色体力回复速度提升20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Increases Team Stamina Recovery Speed by 20% for 900s. Affects only your characters in multiplayer mode.

Description.SourceString: 复刻矿山区域巨型甜筒火山的模样，一口下去，仿佛搭乘矿车穿梭于甜蜜的糖果山谷。
Description.LocalizedString: Modeled after the mine area's giant ice-cream-cone volcano—one bite, and you'll be transported to the mine cart ride through candy-sweet valleys.

UseContext.SourceString: 队伍中所有角色防御力增加75，持续180秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Increases Team DEF by 75 for 180s. Affects only your characters in multiplayer mode.

Description.SourceString: 造型复刻噗仔软乎乎的肉垫手套，带着清甜果香的冰棒，连密封包装袋上都印有可爱的噗仔图案，不可错过的乐园限定！
Description.LocalizedString: A popsicle modeled after Pukaboo's squishy paw-pads, accompanied by a light, sweet, fruity flavor. Even the sealed wrapper is printed with an adorable Pukaboo pattern—an exclusive Pukaland treat!

UseContext.SourceString: 为当前角色恢复生命值上限的20%。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Heals the current character for 20% of their Max HP.

Description.SourceString: 噗卡乐园的人气糖果！宛如一株小小的棉花糖树，一口吃下乐园独一份的甜蜜。
Description.LocalizedString: Pukaland's most popular candy! Resembling a tiny cotton candy tree, each bite delivers the park's extraordinary sweetness.

UseContext.SourceString: 为当前角色恢复700点生命值，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复182点生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Heals the current character for 700 HP, then restores 182 HP every 5s for the next 30s.

Description.SourceString: 吃下糖果，仿佛再次体验高空摇摆时直冲云霄的畅快，我要再去畅游大摆锤啦——
Description.LocalizedString: With each bite, it feels like soaring into the sky on the Pendulum all over again. Let's go ride it again!

UseContext.SourceString: 复活选中角色，并额外恢复700生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Resurrects the selected character and heals them for 700 HP.

Description.SourceString: 海盗章鱼船长紧紧抱着它收获的泡泡糖宝箱！
Description.LocalizedString: The pirate octopus captain clutches his bubblegum treasure chest tightly!

UseContext.SourceString: 为当前角色恢复1600点生命值，并在之后的30秒内，每5秒恢复416点生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Heals the current character for 1,600 HP, then restores 416 HP every 5s for the next 30s.

Description.SourceString: 来自旋转木马摊位的特色美食！餐盒中铺满炸鸡，木马兔子饼干与姜饼人散落其间，咸甜交织，就是热量也很爆炸……
Description.LocalizedString: A signature treat from the carousel stall! The box is packed with fried chicken and carousel bunny cookies, with gingerbread men scattered throughout. A divine mix of sweet and savory—but the calorie count is outrageous…

UseContext.SourceString: 队伍中所有角色攻击力增加125，持续180秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Increases Team ATK by 125 for 180s. Affects only your characters in multiplayer mode.

Description.SourceString: 乐园标志性的人气美食！油润红亮的超大熏烤火鸡腿，分量十足。传闻在异世界的游乐园中也很受欢迎……暂时没人能证实。
Description.LocalizedString: The park's signature crowd-pleaser! A jumbo smoked turkey leg, richly glazed and burnished gold, with plenty of meat on the bone. Rumor has it that it's a hit in amusement parks in the Other World too… though no one's been able to confirm it yet.

UseContext.SourceString: 为当前角色恢复生命值上限的40%。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Heals the current character for 40% of their Max HP.

Description.SourceString: 长度超 35 厘米的巨型热狗，一口下去肉香浓郁，唯一的缺点是真的吃不完……
Description.LocalizedString: A giant hot dog over a foot long. One bite is packed with a rich, meaty flavor—the only downside is that it's impossible to finish…

UseContext.SourceString: 复活选中角色，并恢复生命值上限的40%。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Resurrects the selected character and heals them for 40% of their Max HP.

Description.SourceString: 一套集齐四种噗仔小可爱！可以随意享用……什么，因为太可爱了不舍得吃？
Description.LocalizedString: A full set of four adorable Pukaboo cuties! Enjoy them however you like… What, too cute to eat?

UseContext.SourceString: 为当前角色恢复生命值上限的22%，并额外回复1600点生命值。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Heals the current character for 22% of their Max HP plus an additional 1,600 HP.

Description.SourceString: 荤素满满的丰盛米线大餐！建议不要和烟火熏烤超大火鸡腿一起食用。
Description.LocalizedString: A hearty rice noodle feast, loaded with meat and veggies! Best not to pair it with the Firecracker Jumbo Turkey Leg.

UseContext.SourceString: 队伍中所有角色体力回复速度提升20%，持续900秒。多人游戏时，仅对自己的角色生效。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Stamina Recovery Speed by 20% for 900s. Affects only your characters in multiplayer mode.

Description.SourceString: 曳尔沐的特别定制，萦绕着略带焦苦的温暖气息。很久以后，当你再次嗅到同样的味道时，咖啡表面画着的涂鸦，还会映入记忆的眼帘吗？
Description.LocalizedString: Elyms's special custom blend, with a comforting warmth and a faintly bitter aroma. Later, when you eventually catch the same scent, will the doodle on the coffee's surface come to mind?
